question: Which preserved terrain shader coordinates and component operations are established independently of the still-missing named-map resource-to-sampler link?

scope.boundary: Two hash-identified preserved pixel-program inputs and their paired translations and fetch metadata. Selected guest terrain role stores remain the separate dependency tied to the image. No shader payload, texture pixels, material table or new runtime capture is preserved here.
scope.qualification: Shader arithmetic describes the identified translated programs. Historical paired vertex and fetch metadata is not a proof of a current draw, current host translation, compiled-effect attribution or named-map role binding. Pixel identity uses complete input byte and word digests; paired vertex identity rests on the identified historical record.

dependencies.use: Selected blend and lightmap stores at terrain+0xD4/+0xD8, distinct from sampler slots and fetched components.
Native tile and corner coordinate anchor and the unresolved geometry and provider to texture-coordinate link.
Generic shader, fetch and texture-setter boundary; no terrain-specific role identity follows from it.
Cold type 7 allocation, which applies only under a condition, installs 0x821610D0 before the ready-resource exporter dispatch.
Canonical generic 0x82C8D540 exporter and reference assignment; the terrain instance and stage link are separate.

programIdentity.method: Complete raw preserved microcode and its per-dword-reversed representation were hashed to identify the pixel inputs. Off and on alpha-test specializations reuse each program; they are not additional distinct pixel identities. This finding records program-local arithmetic and historical pairing, without asserting a compiled-container identity.
programIdentity.retainedDrawAnchor: The identified historical records associate the programs with native caller 0x8250C768 and draw entry 0x826A39F8. This is an existing observation locator, not a new invocation or a link from terrain fields to texture slots.

thirteenFetchForm.candidateSlots: Preserved slot 11 is 2048*2048 format 18; slot 12 is 4096*4096 format 18. These make them blend and lightmap candidates only. No preserved record links terrain+0xD4 to 11 or terrain+0xD8 to 12. Slots 8..10 are 512*512 format 18; slot 7 is 1024*1024 format 6. Dimensions do not name materials.
thirteenFetchForm.coordinates: Pixel slots 11 and 12 both sample TEXCOORD3.xy with normalized 2D coordinates and zero explicit fetch offset. In the preserved paired vertex translation, q is the decoded TEXCOORD0 input after its configured integer and float conversion. The common coordinate is u=clamp(q.x+c16.x,0,32768)/32768, v=1-clamp(q.y+c16.y,0,32768)/32768. The numerical clamp and scale come from the preserved vertex literals; retainedConstantBoundary identifies that observation's c16, while its q-to-native and world link remains unlinked. This proves no relative vertical flip in the shader between these slots, if their role identity holds. It supplies no absolute native-map or file-row mapping, texel-centre rule or final filtered edge result.
thirteenFetchForm.guestSampler: The preserved slot 11/12 fetch fields decode as unsigned signs, RGBA fetch swizzle, repeat addressing, linear magnification, minification and mip filtering, disabled anisotropy, mip 0..0 and zero LOD bias. The pixel fetches at microcode offsets 84 and 144 use the fetch-constant filters, computed LOD, no register LOD or gradients, and zero X, Y and Z offsets. Final host binding overrides and component mapping remain separate.
thirteenFetchForm.componentUse: Slot 11 logical fetched x drives interpolation toward slot 8, y toward slot 9, and z toward slot 10, in that order. Intermediate color swizzles are explicit; the third result is saturated. These are successive interpolations, not an unordered normalized three-material sum. Slots 11/12 use only fetched xyz in this selected pixel program; their sampled alpha is not the output-alpha source.
thirteenFetchForm.materialMeaning: Which concrete textures or materials occupy slots 8, 9 and 10, their relation to raw DDS R/G/B, and whether bindings depend on climate or era remain unresolved. Owner-observed red and green effects do not establish a universal material table.
thirteenFetchForm.candidateLighting: Let L be slot 12 logical fetched xyz, C the blended color, a=c255.x, b=c255.y and t=c255.z. The program compares L.x with t. In the L.x>=t arm it adds a before multiplying C; in the other arm it scales L by b before multiplying C, with the stated swizzle ordering. Slot 7 then multiplies that result. Subsequent inverse-square-root and product operations, and constant and interpolant color mixing, remain part of the output path. Thus neither a universally straight lightmap multiply, a fixed overbright factor, nor white neutrality follows without the role and effective-constant links. The program has a multiplicative intermediate, not a complete lightmap-color-space contract.

nativeBindingBoundary.stageSetter: At 0x8269AF10, r3=guest graphics state G,r4=stage,r5=resource header,r6=dirty mask. The nonnull path records r5 at G+0x3100+4*stage and synthesizes six fetch words at G+0x480+24*stage from resource-header fields +0x1C..+0x30 and preserved sampler state. The null path clears the resource pointer without supplying a new header. The caller chooses stage and resource; this body has no fixed terrain-role policy.
nativeBindingBoundary.roleWriter: 0x82C92950 preserves incoming destination r4 in r21 and dispatches current resource virtual+0xC at 0x82C92BE8/0x82C92C20. The accepted cold type 7 class installs 0x821610D0; cell 0x821610DC selects exporter 0x82C8D540. With resource S in r3 and destination D in r4, that method calls 0x821B2440(D,S+0x18) when D is nonnull, then returns 1. It copies the preserved object pointer U32[S+0x18] into the D4/D8 field with reference handling, not a vptr or a direct stage header. Cached and provider objects require their own current-class binding.
nativeBindingBoundary.cleanupDiscriminator: The selected 0x82515F40 cleanup path reads nested+0x58 and calls 0x82515FA8. Its checked prefix through 0x82516044 loops stages 0..25, clears context+0xEE0+4*stage and calls 0x8269AF10 at 0x82515FFC with r5=0. That observed setter site unbinds stages; it does not tie the selected D4/D8 resource to slots 11 and 12. Helper descendants are not treated as covering the full set of paths.
nativeBindingBoundary.drawBoundary: The checked draw function body 0x8250C498 reaches draw instruction 0x8250C764 calling 0x826A39F8 through material and technique and indirect dispatch. The preserved caller locator 0x8250C768 is the post-call return address. The selected body has no direct 0x8269AF10 call or same-instance T+0xD4/+0xD8 link. The matched historical shader record remains the sole program-local source table; a different preserved draw caller or shape does not prove matching VS/PS digests.
nativeBindingBoundary.stopBoundary: For the installed cold type 7 case the resource exporter is resolved. Identify a reached later consumer of the particular pointer now in T+0xD4/+0xD8, its wrapper-to-header conversion and nonnull 0x8269AF10 stage binding in the selected material and technique instance. Current cached and provider class and loaded resource delivery remain premises. Sizes, creation order, equal physical bases across captures and slot names do not supply the missing consumer.
nativeBindingBoundary.stageZeroDiscriminator: A separately inspected setter client calls 0x82517858 at 0x8250E7F4; that complete two-instruction getter returns U32[incoming-r3+0x18]. Call 0x8250E80C passes this returned value as r5 with r4=0; 0x8250EA60 also uses stage 0 with r5=0. These checked sites set or clear stage 0, not slots 11 and 12. Their input object is not linked to T+0xD4/+0xD8, so they supply no role identity or general stage policy.

selectedDrawSetupBoundary.calls: In selected function 0x8250C498, current receiver R preserved in r29 supplies virtual+0x1C at 0x8250C5FC,+0x3C at 0x8250C610,+0x20 at 0x8250C650,+0x24 at 0x8250C684,+0x2C at 0x8250C6A8 and +0x28 at 0x8250C6E0. The +0x2C return is preserved in r31 and passed back as r7 to +0x28; its fields then supply the draw parameters. The current R/vptr/targets and their same-terrain and resource identity are not identified by the preserved shader hashes.
selectedDrawSetupBoundary.qBoundary: The paired translation reads q from decoded input iTexCoord0 at line 503 and computes the common UV at 513..533,579. The preserved record reports stream0_stride_bytes=12 and no vertex textures. This metadata does not identify the buffer contents, vertex producer, height sample source or native axes. Resolve the selected R and its actual setup and vertex-buffer producers before treating any dynamic target as a q producer.
selectedDrawSetupBoundary.constantPolicy: c16=(-512,28160,0,1) is an effective value in one preserved historical guest-state shadow, not proof of a per-map or global policy. The selected material and technique and actual writes reaching G+0x880 are missing. Identify that writer and its map and state inputs, with their values preserved through to the same draw; the generic constant setter or shadow bridge alone cannot establish selection policy.
selectedDrawSetupBoundary.materialBoundary: The same current setup and technique instance must attach the slot 8/9/10 resource descriptors and the two candidate role wrappers. Source file or table entry, climate or era selection and raw DDS-to-logical component transfer remain unresolved. No state-independent material table follows from one record.

receiverSelectionBoundary.scope: Selected function prefix [0x8250C498,0x8250C5D0) and four exact helper bodies under completing valid accesses, ordinary helper returns, compatible save helpers preserving entry arguments, original ABI and nonvolatile preservation, and inputs whose values are preserved. These establish accepted selection paths, not which path the historical draw took. No constructor or current R/vptr is supplied by an address-range or shader-hash association.
origins: At 0x8250C4A4, r29 takes function-entry r10; its nonzero arm branches directly to 0x8250C598.
With entry r10 zero and function-entry r4 nonnull, 0x8250C4D4 requests 0x8235B3B8(G). Its nonzero return is accepted when 0x82513C30 reports ancestry containing descriptor key 0x82F8FCEC.

The other nonnull-G path requests 0x8235C3C0, repeats 0x8235B3B8 and passes that result through 0x82514110; 0x8250C54C preserves the cast return. 0x8235CCF0 is an intervening request, with ordinary preservation required.
When entry r10 and G are zero,0x8250C560 loads r29 from function-entry-r3 renderer+0x708.

A zero receiver after the latter selection paths requests error reporting through 0x823522F0. If that request returns and required accesses complete, renderer virtual+0xF4 at 0x8250C590 can supply the value preserved in r29 at 0x8250C594. No fixed target, constructor or actual return from the error path is established.
receiverSelectionBoundary.geometryAssociatedPath: 0x8235B3B8 uses G+0xCC as an index limited by G+0xC8 and forms entry E=U32[G+0xC0]+16*index. It preserves the G+0xB0/+0xB4 objects and requests 0x823DBE50(E,G,U32[G+0xBC],B0-object,B4-object). These G fields belong to the incoming geometry-associated owner; equal offset+0xB4 does not identify the terrain T+0xB4 height wrapper.
receiverSelectionBoundary.providerFrontier: 0x823DBE50 reads cached E+0 and service U32[E+4]. Its selected paths call that service virtual+0xC at 0x823DBEE0 and virtual+0x10 at 0x823DBF20. A null latter result takes an early zero-return path at 0x823DBF30/0x823DBF34. A nonnull result is offered to 0x821B29B0(E,result), then receives its own virtual+0x14 call at 0x823DBF58. The other return path reloads current U32[E] at 0x823DBF64. Actual E/service/current vptr/targets, helper effects and preserved completion are not identified by the record. No service child is expanded from a guessed instance.
receiverSelectionBoundary.typeChecks: 0x82513C30 calls candidate virtual+8 and follows descriptor-parent words at+4, returning whether the requested key occurs. 0x82514110 returns its original nonnull candidate on a successful check or zero otherwise. It is a checked pointer cast, not a constructor or proof of one concrete derived vtable.
receiverSelectionBoundary.commonJoin: At 0x8250C598 the instruction lwz r11,0(r29) reads the selected receiver vptr. The owner contains no literal installation of that receiver vptr. Entry values, mutable geometry entry and service, renderer fallback and actual helper returns are absent from the matched record, so no constructor or current table can be selected for that historical invocation from this static read set, within the inspected scope.

requiredInstanceEvidence.missingFact: The selected historical R, its current vptr and current setup targets. The accepted selector paths and shader hashes do not determine that object instance.

commonJoin.when: Immediately before lwz r11,0(r29), within the draw function invocation.
commonJoin.qualification: This identifies the selected receiver and vptr, not its selector path, construction history, role fields or native axes. 0x8250C590 is null-fallback-only and cannot replace the common join.

requiredInstanceEvidence.correlation: Collect ordered samples with function-invocation and setup-call ordinals; setup and draw calls can repeat within one function invocation. Associate each preserved draw with its preceding setup and pass events, then select only an actual 0x8250C764 ->0x826A39F8 draw with VS571D6127CBF96DD1 and PS2DEEA7E9B28316E1, matching G=r3 at the draw and its frame and draw sequence. 0x8250C768 is the return and caller locator, also shared by other program forms. An earlier shader binding must not be assumed to remain the program selected by setup. Record receiver/vptr changes instead of combining different instances.
requiredInstanceEvidence.optionalProvenance: Function-entry r3,r4,r10 and LR identify inputs and caller. The last executed receiver assignment among 0x8250C4A4,0x8250C4D8,0x8250C54C,0x8250C560,0x8250C594 distinguishes the accepted origin path; a pointer at the common join alone does not. An observed V narrows a subsequent native constructor and vptr-installation search but does not prove this allocation history.
requiredInstanceEvidence.sufficiency: This evidence would select the actual receiver, table and targets and allow their constructor and producer bodies to be investigated without guessing. It would not yet prove which target attaches stages 11 and 12, supplies stream0/c16 or consumes heights. Those still need same-pointer, resource, vertex and native-coordinate dataflow. No new probe or runtime execution is part of this static finding.

retainedConstantBoundary.identity: The thirteen-fetch historicalRecord directory identified in currentEvidence preserves sibling state.be.bin, a 0x3500-byte guest shadow with SHA-256 430F0C41A6BEA57291888EAEE24B01DE757718FCE16C6A4A0E03B320F3DE1AAD. This is the first preserved observation for that record, not a current named-map execution.
retainedConstantBoundary.vertexOffset: The shadow at G+0x880 supplies vertex c16=(-512,28160,0,1). The recorded vertex header literals affect c252..c255 and do not replace c16. The q-to-native and world links and same-instance terrain links remain separate.
retainedConstantBoundary.pixelLiterals: The historicalRecord record.toml pixel_literals section starts at unified first_float4=508 and supplies indices 508..511, mapping to c252..c255. Pixel c255 has words 3DF8F8F0,3F91B6DB,3F60E0E2,00000000, giving (a,b,t)=(0.12156856060028076,1.1383928060531616,0.8784314393997192). The shadow contains pixel c0..c223 only, so c255 must not be read from a fabricated shadow offset.
retainedConstantBoundary.whiteBoundary: For uniform slot 12 logical RGB=(1,1,1), the L.x>=t arm supplies a multiplicative term 1+a=1.1215685606002808 before the slot 7 product and later inverse-square-root and color mixing. White is not a unit factor at that intermediate. This does not prove final visible brightness or identify slot 12 as the named-map lightmap.
retainedConstantBoundary.slotSeven: The selected pixel code clamps the separately fetched slot 7 RGB to 0..1 before multiplying the candidate-lit color. The record identifies a 1024*1024 format 6 resource with fetch base 0x1E3B0000, not its pixels or sampled values. Slot 7 is not an identified constant scalar and its final compensation remains unresolved.
retainedConstantBoundary.qualification: Preserved shadow and header values and the identified translated program only. Literal override ordering follows the recorder and native-literal bridge under their stated resource premises. No current draw, named-map slot identity, texture-pixel value or camera or native-axis relationship is inferred.

eightFetchForm.contract: Only slots 0..7 are sampled. The selected program combines squared and swizzled sources 0..3 using logical scalar components from 4..6, then multiplies by slot 7 and applies a later color term. It has no slot 11/12 fetch and no 2048 or 4096 candidate in its preserved metadata. Do not merge this program's texture and lighting contract with the thirteen-fetch form.

remainingBlockers.needed: Establish the actual selected setup receiver and targets, role pointers, programs and visible red-material source for the same pass, then the named DDS-to-resource row order. The shared slot 11/12 UV equation has no relative offset under those premises, which are not yet established; the owner observation alone selects neither a flip nor an offset.

currentEvidence.method: Read-only complete program hashing, preserved translated-code and dataflow inspection and guest fetch and instruction-field decoding against the maintained SDK definitions. Native role-store evidence is reused from the dependency tied to the image, not inferred from artifact names. Additional foreground read-only native word queries verified the generic setter, role-manager indirect writer and one cleanup discriminator against the pinned image. None supplies the missing same-instance role and stage link.

guards: Closed status closes the selected shader read set; all three named-map file-to-native coordinate mappings are not yet established.
Keep fetched logical components, guest fetch swizzle, raw DDS channels and final host component mapping distinct.
Do not call source slot 8 snow, slot 9 grass or slot 10 rock without a resource and material binding.
The shared v complement is a shader-local equation, not a native north/south or camera convention.
Derived HLSL, historical draw metadata and complete input program hashes establish different evidence boundaries. No current runtime effect is claimed.
conclusion: The shared thirteen-fetch UV and arithmetic and the role exporter, which applies only under a condition, remain established. The selected draw receiver can originate from an entry argument, geometry-associated cached or service result, renderer+0x708 or renderer virtual+0xF4; type checks select no unique derived constructor or table. The inspected historical record preserves API-call and D3D state rather than the owner R/vptr/current targets, so the current instance cannot be selected from this read set. requiredInstanceEvidence identifies the exact join, dispatch registers and same-draw program correlation needed next. Native axes, named-role stage identities, q and c16 producers and policy, height reader, materials and raw RGB and the quadrant-row cause are not yet established; no resolved generic slot is reopened.
